semantic_atoms.claim: Historical Project-Frankenstein contains at least two distinct pre-effect control families: the agentic ToolExecutor approval/risk plane and ProjectEngine path-local guards/sandboxing.
No source evidence observed in this pass establishes that all historical effect entry classes converge through one canonical policy/effect decision before execution.

The strongest reusable predecessor pattern is not any single historical guard implementation but the combination of pre-execution decision plus synchronous result capture; Frankenstein 2.0 must add exact causal identity and a single authority boundary rather than preserve the fragmented topology.
